tasks.description:

- Modify: `tests/unit/headless-backend.test.ts`
- Modify: `tests/unit/headless-parity.test.ts`

- [ ] Each of the eleven methods is registered with a literal `method('name', …)` call and calls the same core function, with the same argument checks, as its `handle('name', …)` twin in `src/main/index.ts:526-696`.

tasks.description:
